summary: NNIT A/S provides information technology solutions for life sciences, public, and private sectors in Denmark, Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company provides cybersecurity, regulatory affairs, AI, laboratory, drug safety, compliance, quality, SAP solutions, software engineering, digital manufacturing, clinical, data and cloud, supply chain, tech transition consulting, legacy transformation, and first-time launch services, as well as Microsoft and Veeva solutions, and migration solutions by valiance. NNIT A/S was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark.
